table_mode: All LLD-05 owned tables are SQLite STRICT, use LLD-02 canonical UUIDv4 internal IDs, LLD-01 INTEGER UTC whole-second instants, explicit CHECK constraints, required FK indexes and no business identifier as relational PK/FK.
hard_delete_rule: Dedicated hard-delete service may remove only eligible manually created current-domain rows/dependent draft links after preview, receipt and cross-domain guards; append-only audit_events remain. Source-adopted WFM, execution/review/retry/history-bearing Task rows are never eligible.
implementation_rule: The three leaves form one normative Task core schema. Exact-schema verification and migration coverage include every table, CHECK constraint and required index declared by all leaves.
